bio: Here, the Wiener schnitzel is the obvious choice – it's best to order it mit allen Schikanen (with all the trimmings)! At this attractive restaurant on the Ring that encircles Vienna's old town, good food is accompanied by classical music, Viennese service culture and an elegant yet pleasantly down-to-earth atmosphere. In the open kitchen (which is also visible from outside), you can see the schnitzels being pounded. Why not take part in the weekly schnitzel course. There is even a book for sale: The Wiener Schnitzel Love Book....
